end.summary:
Practised naming circle parts: centre, radius, diameter, arc, chord, segment, and sector.
Used visual examples including a pizza slice and a straight-cut piece.
Initially mixed up sector and segment; corrected this in turns 6–7.
Initially treated every chord as passing through the centre; corrected this in turns 10–11.
Teach-back was not passed; 3 of 6 unaided attempts were correct.
end.parentNote: Dev practised identifying circle parts by describing their boundaries and position, with pizza-slice and straight-cut examples. They corrected the sector–segment mix-up and clarified that every diameter is a chord, but not every chord is a diameter; these corrections were still accurate at the later checks. At home, ask Dev to label a circle and explain each part in one sentence.
